principles: Pastel base (tints at 85-92% lightness) for backgrounds and panels
3px outline on all gameplay pieces and buttons in a 25% darker shade of the fill (HSL L -25), never pure black
Rounded sans display (Fredoka / M PLUS Rounded 1c / Zen Maru Gothic for JP) 700 for titles
palette_strategy: Pastel base (tints at 85-92% lightness) for backgrounds and panels; exactly 3 saturated accents reserved for CTA, reward and selection states; never more than 2 saturated hues on one screen outside reward moments

illustration.asset_rendering: vector flat with one soft shade band in a hue-shifted (toward purple) darker tone

components.button.primary: Pill primary 56px tall, fill = primary, 3px darker-shade outline, 4px hard bottom shadow, label 18px 700 centred with 1px darker text shadow; secondary = surface fill with primary outline; pressed = translate 3px down and drop shadow in 90ms
components.popup: Rounded panel radius 28px, surface fill, 4px outline in secondary-darker, ribbon title plate overlapping the top edge by 50%; close button circular 44px top-right; entrance scale 0.85 to 1 with overshoot 1.04 in 260ms
components.hud: Top bar 64px with coin/life/timer capsules (pill, surface fill, 2px outline); timer bar uses accent fill with rounded ends; never more than 3 capsules; gameplay grid gets at least 85% of vertical space in portrait
components.reward: Reward popups go one saturation step higher (accent plus gold); confetti of 3 shapes max (circle, star, heart) in palette colours; mascot cheer pose; sparkle burst 6-8 rays; bounce to 1.1 scale synced to sound

anti_patterns: Thin stroke icons mixed with filled
Sharp-corner tiles next to pill buttons
More than 3 saturated hues on the gameplay screen
qa_criteria: All outlines are darker shades of their own fill, never #000
Corner radius within the xl class on every panel and button
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 on the cream background
Tile silhouettes identical size and radius across the grid
Reward screen uses the same character style as home

intentional_exceptions.rule: tile radius lg instead of xl
